title: Product review sentiment research with multiple agents
description: Read a product's reviews from several angles at once, vote across the results, and produce a single trustworthy sentiment verdict.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: product-review-sentiment
  title: Product review sentiment research with multiple agents
  description: Read a product's reviews from several angles at once, vote across the results, and produce a single trustworthy sentiment verdict.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Give a shopper a trustworthy read on how a product actually performs for real owners, without being fooled by a few loud or fake reviews.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor: []
  nodes:
    - id: reviews-intake
      kind: input
      name: Product reviews and listing
      summary: The product and the body of customer reviews to analyze.
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The product being researched, plus the reviews, review pages, or review export to analyze. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: complaint-pattern-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Recurring complaint analyst
      summary: Looks for complaints that repeat across many independent reviewers.
      role: Analyst hunting for genuine, recurring product defects rather than one-off gripes.
      prompt: Read the reviews and identify complaints that recur across multiple independent reviewers rather than a single unhappy customer. For each recurring complaint, note roughly how often it appears and quote representative language. Flag any complaint cluster that looks incentivized, templated, or otherwise low-trust rather than treating every complaint at face value, and say plainly when the evidence for a complaint is thin.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: praise-pattern-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Genuine praise analyst
      summary: Looks for praise that reflects real satisfied use, not marketing language.
      role: Analyst distinguishing genuine owner satisfaction from generic promotional praise.
      prompt: Read the reviews and identify praise that reflects specific, plausible real-world use rather than generic marketing phrasing. For each praise pattern, note roughly how often it appears and quote representative language. Flag reviews whose praise looks incentivized, templated, or otherwise low-trust rather than counting them as genuine satisfaction, and say plainly when a positive pattern rests on thin evidence.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: low-trust-review-hunter
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Low-trust review hunter
      summary: Specifically hunts for fake, incentivized, or templated reviews.
      role: Adversarial analyst whose only job is spotting reviews that should not be trusted.
      prompt: Scan the reviews specifically for signs of fake, incentivized, or templated content, such as repeated phrasing across reviewers, unnatural enthusiasm, disclosed free products, posting bursts, or generic text that could apply to any product. List each suspect review or cluster with the specific signal that triggered suspicion, and estimate what share of the review set looks low-trust. Do not accuse a review of being fake without pointing to a concrete signal.
      capabilities: { skills: [application-security], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: sentiment-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel sentiment research
      summary: Run the complaint, praise, and low-trust analysts side by side over the same review set.
      config: { members: [complaint-pattern-analyst, praise-pattern-analyst, low-trust-review-hunter], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: sentiment-vote
      kind: aggregator
      name: Vote across analysts
      summary: Combine the three analysts' findings so no single outlier source dominates the verdict, and surface where they disagree.
      config: { aggregation: vote }
    - id: sentiment-verdict
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Overall sentiment verdict
      summary: Synthesize a single sentiment verdict with confidence and the specific recurring issues.
      role: Neutral synthesizer producing one defensible verdict from several independent read-throughs.
      prompt: Using the voted, combined findings, produce one overall sentiment verdict for the product along with a confidence level and the specific recurring issues and strengths that back it up. Discount anything the low-trust hunter flagged as suspect, and lower your confidence when the three analysts disagree with each other or when the low-trust share of reviews was high. Do not state a specific rating or number that was not derived from the upstream findings.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } }, confidence: { type: string }, recurringIssues: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.6 }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Sentiment verdict
      summary: The final sentiment verdict, confidence, and the recurring issues or strengths driving it.
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: reviews-intake, to: sentiment-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: sentiment-group, to: sentiment-vote, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: sentiment-vote, to: sentiment-verdict, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: sentiment-verdict, to: result, kind: data }
